gen-fs-oswald-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Confident Oswald packs its rows of text tight, with strokes that barely taper where they meet or end. BhuTuka Expanded One slows everything to a leisurely walk, its curvy serif letters joined without any tapering.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Ornate Almendra Display leads with a tall x-height and letters that never pinch shut, giving the heading a literary air. Hedvig Letters Sans makes paragraphs feel approachable, with generous gaps in every c.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-lexend-mega: Red Hat Display draws every line like a marker, with visible daylight inside each curve and a bold, contemporary feel. Beneath it, Lexend Mega stands taller in lowercase, nearly meeting capitals.
gen-almendra-display-gf-huninn: Storybook flourish up top comes from Almendra Display, whose tall x-height keeps its letters from ever pinching shut. Huninn holds against it with strokes that never waver from stem to curve.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-work-sans: Work Sans moves along with c tips that never creep toward touching and a high mean line. Red Hat Display, drawn like a marker, leads while longer stretches of the sans-serif text stay modern and unhurried.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, a heavy-looking strip of text through the middle. Red Hat Display is best at bold marker-like lines with daylight in every curve, Supreme at holding its letters open.
gen-almendra-display-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri reads friendly, with rounded letters that stay open. Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut, and the clear difference in feeling from the sans makes the pairing memorable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-liter: A storybook flourish leads here, Almendra Display with its pronounced x-height and never-pinching letters. Liter is tubelike sans with zero stroke contrast, and that sheer lack of flourish is what sets the pair apart.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mada: Fairy-tale flourish comes from Almendra Display, whose tall x-height and never-pinching letters give it a literary, ornate feel. Mada follows with towering midzone curves that refuse to close, approachable and modern.
gen-almendra-display-gf-michroma: Ornate Almendra Display leads, its letters never pinching shut. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth on both sides, and that spacious, tall-bodied sans is the quality that defines the pair.
